name: Himekoisou
source:
Main character is asked by his grandfather to manage a boarding house. Only beautiful girls live there. They all try to use their charms and seduce protagonist for various reasons.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公受祖父之托，负责经营一间公寓。那里住的全是美少女，而她们也各怀目的，纷纷施展魅力，试图诱惑主人公。
